newsitem.title: USA: Sabre Group comfortable with Q1 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Sabre Group comfortable with Q1 estimates.

text.p: Sabre Group Holdings Inc Chief Executive Michael Durham said he was comfortable with Wall Street's consensus earnings estimate of $0.51 a share for the first quarter and $1.63 a share for the full year 1997.
Sabre Group is the largest distributor of travel data in the U.S. and also provides information technology solutions for the travel industry. Sabre Group is majority-owned by AMR Corp.
Earlier on Monday, Sabre announced a $140 million contract to create products that will help modernize airline management technology for the airlines of the former Soviet Union.

Sabre, working with International Business Machines Corp and AT&T Corp's AT&T Tridom unit, will create Sirena-3, a suite of products that will improve the way the airlines book reservations, manage fares and prices and perform revenue accounting, scheduling and yield management.
International Technology Corp-Sirena, a private Russian company based located in Moscow, will market the new products to the airlines of the Commonwealth on Independent States, Sabre said.
Sabre Group lost 1/4 to 24-1/2 in late afternoon trading.
